Sante Raises $15M to Run Wine and Liquor Stores on One AI-Powered Operating System. Darren Fike took a part-time job at a TriBeCa wine shop to find out why some of the best stores in New York ran on the worst software. What he learned inside an industry of roughly 34,000 independent stores became the basis for AI agents that reprice slow-moving bottles and read distributor invoices on their own.
